name: record_ban
description: Guard records ban status and start date in ledger

prompt.template:
You are acting as the lake guard. Please record the ban status and start date in the ledger.

Record the fisher who is banned and when the ban started.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{{"banned_fisher": {{"agent_id": "<agent_id>", "ban_start": <number>, "reasoning": "<one or two sentences, in character>"}}}}
